answer: The bond is locked for 7 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the oasis lockup is upheld by the sable escrow, the lagoon audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
